## Delays vary by district, by age and by wave

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="42%"}
- Fitting each stratum on its own runs out of data. Partial pooling
  shares what the small strata cannot support
- `brms` already has the regression machinery, so `epidist` puts the
  censored likelihood behind a `brms` formula

::: {.attribution}
Sierra Leone Ebola line list, `epidist/vignettes/ebola.Rmd:246-253`,
sampler arguments cut ·
[epidist](https://epidist.epinowcast.org/) ·
[brms](https://paulbuerkner.com/brms/)
:::
:::
::: {.column width="58%"}
```r
fit <- epidist(
  data = obs_prep,
  formula = bf(
    mu ~ 1 + sex + (1 | district),
    sigma ~ 1 + sex + (1 | district)
  ),
  family = lognormal()
)
```
:::
::::

::: {.callout-note}
The delay family has to be one `brms` knows, and the Stan code is
assembled by string substitution before it compiles.
:::
